content: Patients who are hospitalized may continue to manage their own diabetes if they demonstrate the capability to do so and if the hospital environment supports such self-management practices. This approach is particularly relevant for children, adolescents, and individuals who can safely perform diabetes self-management tasks under appropriate supervision. These patients must possess sufficient knowledge regarding dietary intake, insulin dosing, and the management of diabetes during periods of illness. Additionally, healthcare staff should provide necessary support to ensure the safety and effectiveness of self-management during hospitalization.
